title: Optimal entanglement-assisted source coding under a balanced-difference promise
summary: Entanglement can reduce the communication required for coding tasks, but establishing the minimum achievable cost is essential to understanding its limits. We address this question in a zero-error source-coding task where Alice receives a word and Bob knows an unordered pair of candidates containing it. Alice does not know the pair and must enable Bob to identify her word without error using shared entanglement and one classical message.
